text:
The central conflict in the text is an ethical dilemma faced by Captain Reyes and her crew. They must choose between adhering to the Prime Directive, which prohibits interfering with undeveloped civilizations, and acting to save an alien species whose planet is on the brink of destruction. This creates an internal conflict within the crew as they debate the moral implications of inaction versus the consequences of violating their core directive.

The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.
